title: cyperus pilosulus
intro: Cyperus pilosulus, commonly known as the hairy flatsedge, is a type of grass-like plant that belongs to the sedge family. It is native to tropical regions of Asia and has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is said to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to treat conditions like wounds, fever, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Cyperus pilosulus include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
